scope: bounded proposed family; not a universal impossibility or exhaustive novelty verdict
positive_feasibility: For common H and actual linear P_m=P_0+S_m, P_m H=P_0 H+S_m H exactly; private sparse corrections can add receiver-level evidence and their work remains.
insufficient_shortcut: P_0 Hbar+S_m Hbar generally omits both contrast terms; sparse edited-row corrections do not recover full original-topology contrast elsewhere.
bank_boundary: Private maps over a shared finite graph bank select existing evidence; evolving degree-K bank costs K graph applications, storage and backward work.
error_boundary: Distinct/orthogonal/zero-sum structural responses do not guarantee reduced nonlinear prediction-error covariance or deployed pooled loss.
learner_gap: No precise supported estimator, objective, update or identification result distinguished from saved multiscale, structural MoE, graph-learning/repair and graph-residual initialization operations.

existing_direction_preserved.status: narrow saved bound/cost allocation principle; no new promotion or launch here
existing_direction_preserved.nature: approximation of full member contrasts at fixed original operator, not newly learned structural routes

falsifiable_comparison: Given a frozen common backbone and disclosed additional structural measurement budget, do separately supervised route corrections improve deployed pooled prediction beyond identical evidence/forward capacity trained by pooled loss?

backbone_limits.PolyFormer: Private coefficients over cached token rows are bank mixing; private edge operators change/extend preprocessing evidence.
backbone_limits.Polynormer: Member state/edge changes alter attention normalization and later global statistics; fixed-linear sparse-update parity is unqualified.
